links.outcome: Correlation between LLM stated decision confidence and accuracy (calibration of confidence)
links.effect: GPT-5 showed significant positive confidence-accuracy correlation (Group A r=0.54; Group B r=0.55, both P<0.01); other models' correlations were inconsistent and unstable.
links.quote: The confidence-accuracy correlations for the other models were inconsistent and unstable.

links.outcome: Comparison of four LLMs' treatment decision accuracy against real-world treatment outcomes on same cases
links.effect: With structured records (Group B), GPT-5 accuracy 88%, Gemini 2.5 Pro 62%, DeepSeek-R1 58%, Grok-4 42%.
links.quote: Under the same conditions, the other models showed inferior performance (Gemini 2.5 Pro: 62% accuracy; DeepSeek-R1: 58%; Grok-4: 42%).

unlisted_practices: Adding structured medical record information to structured radiology reports as LLM input improved treatment decision performance
Using analytic hierarchy process composite scoring to compare LLMs

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing the diagnostic/treatment decision-making accuracy and confidence calibration of multiple LLMs on 26 real-world cases under different input formats (radiology reports alone vs. reports plus clinical records). It evaluates model performance directly without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
